दक्षिण रेलव/ेSOUTHERN RAILWAY 

    चने्न ैमंडल/CHENNAI DIVISION 

No. PUB/MAS/2024/07/09                                   Date: 13.07.2024 

 

पे्रसिवज्ञक्षि /PRESS RELEASE 

 
LINE BLOCK CANCELLED BETWEEN CHENNAI EGMORE AND VILLUPURAM SECTION 
 
Due to rains and Meteorological department rain forecast for next 3days, the Line Block 

announced vide Press Release No: PUB/MAS/2024/07/06 DATED 12.07.2024  in 
Chennai Egmore - Villupuram Section  on 14.07.2024  STANDS CANCELLED. 

Subsequently, all diversions and to operate Express Trains on UP Suburban line 
between Tambaram - Chennai Egmore STANDS CANCELLED and Suburban train services in Chennai Beach - Chengalpattu 
section will be operated as per schedule (Sunday Pattern of service) on 14-07-2024. 

Sd/-
